name: @ours.network/installer
description: The unified ours.network stack installer (ours-install): one guided ~3-minute flow for ours core (the daemon) + the harness plugins (Claude Code / Codex) + ours-fleet + the Telegram connector, then a single copy-paste hand-off prompt. Runnable as `ours-install` or via curl|bash (install.sh); not published to npm.
author: Adapt Toolkit
